## Decision

What decision needs to be made or recorded?

## Status

- [ ] Proposed
- [ ] Accepted
- [ ] Rejected
- [ ] Superseded

## Context

Why is this decision needed?

## Options Considered

### Option A

### Option B

### Option C

## Recommended Direction

Which option should we choose, and why?

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder after this decision?

## Revisit Trigger

When should this decision be revisited?

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Decision is clearly stated.
- [ ] Trade-offs are documented.
- [ ] Result is verified after commit.
- [ ] ASCII diagrams, if any, have aligned `|` characters.
- [ ] Commit hash is reported.
